verdict.rationale: Webhooks are a fair axis for a customer data platform, but the pack never documents registrable outbound HTTP callbacks that a programmatic consumer can receive. The only nearby items are bare page titles ('Forward data to a downstream services', 'Build your own custom integrations') and audience outputs routed to partner integrations. These are adjacent forwarding and integration features, not webhook subscriptions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
